_meta.what: One row per real-time module: when its session opens and closes, and how much history it needs before its own stage.
_meta.source: docs/analysis/rt_module_selection.md group A ('decides at' and the look-back notes) + the slice experiment in tasks/notes/PF-Q2-02.md
rules: open_on null = from the first frame of the session; close_on null = until the end-of-session marker.
The events do not exist yet: the stage detector (PF-Q1-03) owns them. Until it publishes, every gate is open and a run records that.
Gating must not change a verdict: a gated run is compared with an always-open run on the module sample before this table is used (ADR-004).
_meta.owners: gate proposal — Valentyn; events — Maksym Ch. (PF-Q1-03); review — Oksana, Ihor

beltloader-chocks.decides_at: the aircraft departure (live: the tracker's departure frame)

bl_rear_cone.decides_at: the belt loader in place and its window

3-stop-brake-check.decides_at: the belt loader stopped at the aircraft; it counts the stops since the belt loader started approaching, so it cannot open at its own decision (measured: a 4-minute pre-roll turns Fail into Not observed)

pushback-pathway-confirmed-clear-of-obst.decides_at: around T_dep (live: 15 s after the departure frame)

conditioned-air-removed-10-mins-prior-to.decides_at: departure confirmed (live: 11 s after); keeps whole-event hose history, so it opens at T_ARR

chocks-and-cones-available-and-staged-fo.decides_at: T_arr (pre-arrival check: it is open before the aircraft is there)

crew-present-10-minutes-prior-to-aircraf.decides_at: T_arr; it keeps processing 60 s after its verdict is fixed (rt_module_selection.md)
